name: @niq.run/interface-worker
description: The generic out-of-process interface worker for niq — exposes the bus to a local harness (CLI form today: send directed events, request a capability reply, stream bus events) with pluggable outward forms. Credentials come from a local multi-source file matching the WebUI's remote-worker connect block.

scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "Error: git working tree not clean" >&2; exit 1; } && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm version --no-git-tag-version && npm publish
